chunks: Al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah narrated from Burayd al-'Ijli, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, sent down to Adam a huri from Paradise, and he married her to one of his two sons. The other married a daughter of the jinn. So whatever abundant beauty or good character there is among people is from the huri, and whatever bad character there is among them is from the daughter of the jinn.

key_terms.حَوْرَاءَ: a woman from Paradise of heavenly origin

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about the origin of beauty and character among people?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an account about the origins of certain qualities found among human beings through marriages connected to the offspring of Adam. It links beauty and good character to a heavenly source, while attributing evil character to the daughter of the jinn mentioned in the report.
